ops.quote: The input X consists of four consecutive game frames and an action a.
Stacked convolution layers process the visual input.
The actions are one-hot-encoded and embedded in a vector
The embedded action vector is multiplied channel-wise with the output of the convolutional layers.
The network outputs the next frame of the game and the value of the reward.
We used the clipped loss max(Loss, C) for a constant C.
At each timestep, a latent value zt is sampled from this distribution.
The reward is predicted by a softmax attached to the last fully connected layer.
At test time, the latent values are sampled from an assumed prior N (0, I).
We used dropout equal to 0.2 and layer normalization.
randomly replacing in training some frames of the input X by the prediction from the previous step
an additional network receives the input frames as well as the future target frame as input and approximates the distribution of the posterior.
the proposed stochastic model with discrete latent variables discretizes the latent values into bits
the latent bits will be generated by this auxiliary network in contrast to sampling from a prior.
we add uniform noise to approximated latent values before discretization
apply dropout on bits after discretization
the algorithm generates rollouts in the simulated environment env ′
uses them to improve policy π.
uniformly sample the starting state from the ground-truth buffer D
restart env ′
add to the reward the evaluation of the value function
the world model is trained for 45K steps in the first iteration
the agent is trained inside the latest world model using PPO
the agent performs 15.2M interactions with the simulated environment env ′
